briefing: Markets were neutral today with the NASDAQ up 0.7% and the S&P 500 up 0.3% — no strong risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 threshold for a new position, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a lukewarm session.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely attractive opportunity appears, rather than being spent just to stay fully invested. Today's neutral market and below-threshold cash balance are a textbook case for holding dry powder instead of forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」(Dry Powder)是指投資人保留在場邊、尚未投入市場的現金,目的是等待真正有吸引力的機會出現時再出手,而不是為了維持滿倉而勉強交易。今天市場走勢中性,現金水位也低於門檻,正是應該保留現金、耐心等待的典型情況。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted small gains today, with the NASDAQ (+0.7%) outpacing the S&P 500 (+0.3%), suggesting mild outperformance in growth and tech names without a clear catalyst driving broad risk appetite. The muted, roughly-in-line-with-average move points to a consolidation day rather than a decisive trend shift. With no standout headlines to explain the move, it looks like ordinary day-to-day price drift rather than a reaction to major news.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和,那斯達克指數上漲0.7%,表現優於標普500指數的0.3%漲幅,顯示科技與成長股略為領先大盤,但並無明顯催化因素帶動整體風險偏好。這種溫和且接近平均值的波動,較像是盤整格局,而非趨勢性的轉變。由於沒有重大新聞可解釋這次波動,較可能只是市場的日常價格波動,而非對重大消息的反應。
